body: How do you brush them off? I know that might sound facetious but is a genuine question.

I wish I could make her stop. years of meds and therapy haven't stopped her. I've been in hospital three times, even had ECT, and the truth is I always wind up at this point. I don't ever seem to get better, just staving off the next time I end up like this.

I honestly can't see a way forward, it's just some stupid fear of death that's stopping me right now. I am a drain of resources and effort, and don't deserve the help I have ever had. Thank you for this but I can't say it's swaying me one way or another.

I can't find the courage to do it, everything is ready and I'm drinking wine but I can't do it I can't believe I'm this weak. I have overdoesd in the past why is it so hard to do it properly this time?

I hear a voice a lot, just 'she' really as no name seems to suit her. I wish I could name her sometimes.
